arStrings.szText: {if:SF.IsMythic}{c_mythic}{/if}You can now equip all base {c_important}Ultimate{/c} Skills and gain {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1"]{/c} Ranks in them. Attacking enemies with no active {c_important}Ultimate{/c} Skill builds up your {c_important}Ultimate{/c} Skill damage by {if:SF.IsMythic}{c_number}{else}{c_random}{/if}[Affix_Value_1*100|%x|]{/c}, up to {if:SF.IsMythic}{c_number}{else}{c_random}{/if}[Affix_Value_1*100*Affix."Static Value 0"|x%|]{/c}. After starting {c_important}Ultimate{/c} Skills the damage bonus is reset once all have ended.{if:SF.IsMythic}{/c_mythic}{/if}
